collection.title: Skoda Superb Hatchback 2015 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Skoda Superb Hatchback 2015 Onwards will fit, this model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.

image.alt: Skoda Superb Hatchback 2015 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
